# Simplilearn

> > Simplilearn is a comprehensive online bootcamp and certification platform offering professional training in AI, Data Science, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Project Management with university partnerships and corporate solutions.

Simplilearn provides industry-recognized certification courses, free learning resources, and corporate training programs designed to help professionals upskill in emerging technologies. The platform partners with universities and enterprises to deliver bootcamps and hands-on training across tech and business domains.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI & LLMs
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Python Programming
- SQL
- Project Management (PMP)
- Cloud Computing
- DevOps
- Cybersecurity
- Business Analytics
- Professional Certifications
- Online Bootcamps
- Corporate Training
- Career Development
- Digital Skills

## Core Platform & Programs

- [Simplilearn Homepage](https://www.simplilearn.com): Main platform hub for online bootcamps and certification courses with university partnerships
- [Free Online Courses & Certificates](https://www.simplilearn.com/skillup-free-online-courses): Free courses and certificates in AI, Data Science, SQL, and Business Analytics
- [Corporate Training Programs](https://www.simplilearn.com/corporate-training): Employee upskilling programs for enterprises in GenAI, Data Science, Cloud, and Cybersecurity

## AI & Generative AI Courses

- [Generative AI Courses & Certifications](https://www.simplilearn.com/certifications/generative-ai-courses): Courses covering prompt engineering, ChatGPT, LLMs, and agentic AI applications
- [AI & Machine Learning Courses](https://www.simplilearn.com/ai-and-machine-learning): AI and ML courses with Python training for various industry roles

## Data Science & Analytics

- [Data Science Courses Online](https://www.simplilearn.com/data-science-and-business-analytics): Data Science courses with SQL, Python, Power BI, and analytics certifications

## Project Management & Leadership

- [Project Management Courses](https://www.simplilearn.com/project-management): PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 certifications and leadership training programs
- [PMP Certification Training](https://www.simplilearn.com/project-management/pmp-certification-training): Professional Project Manager certification with exam prep and PMI requirements guidance

## Learning Resources & Support

- [Free Learning Resources](https://www.simplilearn.com/resources): Articles, eBooks, and webinars on AI, Data Science, and project management

## Partnership & Instructor Programs

- [Reseller Partner Program](https://www.simplilearn.com/reseller-partner-program-for-training-courses): Authorized training partner program to resell and distribute courses
- [Become a Trainer](https://www.simplilearn.com/become-our-trainer): Instructor recruitment for PMP, Agile, Cloud, DevOps, and tech certifications
